dsaPatterns.summary: Turn O(N^2) scans into O(N) with frequency maps and moving windows.

dsaPatterns.summary: Search sorted data, rotated data, or the answer range itself.

dsaPatterns.title: Linked Lists
dsaPatterns.summary: Pointer manipulation, cycle detection and list splicing.

dsaPatterns.title: Stacks, Queues & Monotonic Structures
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Keep the stack monotonic; pop while the incoming element breaks the order.

dsaPatterns.title: Trees & BSTs
dsaPatterns.summary: Recursive divide and conquer plus level-order traversal.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Compute left, compute right, combine at the node, return to the parent.

dsaPatterns.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
dsaPatterns.summary: Track running extremes and top-K in O(log N).
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: For the K largest, keep a min-heap of size K.

dsaPatterns.title: Graphs & Grid Traversal

dsaPatterns.title: Recursion & Backtracking
dsaPatterns.summary: Enumerate choices, prune early, undo state.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: Always undo the choice after the recursive call returns.

dsaPatterns.title: Greedy & Intervals
dsaPatterns.summary: Locally optimal choices that stay globally optimal.
dsaPatterns.cheatSheet: If you cannot argue why the local choice is safe, it is probably DP.

dsaPatterns.title: Dynamic Programming
dsaPatterns.summary: Optimal substructure and overlapping subproblems on arrays, strings and grids.
